recordSchema.story: non-empty array of NUL-free English source sentences
recordSchema.question: source question with two named agents
recordSchema.label: host-only member of the declared nine-relation answer domain
recordSchema.k_hop: integer encoded by the source as a decimal string

unsupportedTemplate.reason: The official template omits one entity placeholder and therefore cannot encode a binary relation.

templateCatalog.ambiguityPolicy: A sentence is accepted only if all matching official templates imply the same ordered typed relation. Zero matches are UNMATCHED_TEMPLATE; more than one distinct implication is AMBIGUOUS_TEMPLATE. Neither condition is repaired from the answer label.

splitIsolation.train: available for source profiling and development-visible analysis
splitIsolation.validation: complete development pool; host oracle used only after inference
splitIsolation.test: schema- and source-profiled without scoring, label aggregation, or solver execution
